items.title: D-Mart Q2 revenue rises 18% to Rs 19,206 cr; store count at 518
items.description: Avenue Supermarts has achieved an impressive 18.4% growth in standalone revenue for the second quarter of 2026, totaling Rs 19,206.18 crore, a substantial rise from Rs 16,218.79 crore compared to the same period last year. This also reflects a 4.7% increase from the preceding quarter's revenue of Rs 18,343.49 crore.
